titulo.alumno:
«Отрицание результата»
Negating an action or its result

intro: Не читал may deny the activity or indicate that one did not read; не прочитал usually denies completion or the expected result.

frases.estudio: Я не читал эту статью раньше.
frases.alumno: I had not read this article before.

frases.estudio: Я не прочитал отчёт до конца.
frases.alumno: I did not finish reading the report.

piezas.titulo: Не читал may deny the activity or indicate that one did not read; не прочитал usually denies completion or the expected result.
texto: Не читал may deny the activity or indicate that one did not read; не прочитал usually denies completion or the expected result.
In factual texts, look for complements such as до конца, ни разу or весь to interpret the scope.

pregunta.texto: Which sentence denies that the report was finished?

opciones.explicacion: До конца makes the unreached result explicit.
